s.how: Mix 150ml tomato juice reduced to thick with horseradish, Worcestershire, celery salt and lemon. Serve with 500g cooked prawns. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: the LA beach Fletch goes undercover on
s.how: Cut 500g white fish into bites, roll in flour, egg and 100g panko and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Serve with lemon and 150g tartare.

m.n: Steak sandwich and a steak sandwich
m.note: the order on the Underhills' tab
m.how: Pan-fry 4 thin rump steaks for 2 minutes a side. Fry 2 sliced onions. Serve on toasted bread with mustard and lettuce. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream and pour over hot fudge sauce. Serve it at the halfway point of the film. Leave it out for anyone who wants seconds.

d.note: the drink on the Underhills' tab
d.how: Mix 45ml vodka, 150ml tomato juice, lemon, Worcestershire and celery salt for each glass over ice. Virgin for the kids. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
